guardrails: An `unclear` or abstained answer goes to a human; it is scored as wrong, so abstaining is never free.
The schema-valid rate must stay at or above 98%.
Never auto-close, auto-send or auto-approve a model answer; a person makes the final call.

output_schema.description: T-DOCS: an answer with the passage ids it cites, or an explicit abstention.
output_schema.title: DocsOut

prompt:
You answer a question about this project using only the passages supplied with the
question. Cite the passage ids you used. If the passages do not contain the answer,
abstain instead of guessing.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"answer": "<answer>", "cited_ids": ["<passage id>", ...], "abstained": false}
Set "abstained" to true and "cited_ids" to [] when the passages do not answer it.

Question:
{text}
recheck_trigger: `wam recheck run --tasks T-DOCS --against results/runs/live` when a new model is released, when a model changes under the same id, or after a prompt change (that needs a new baseline run first).
title: Answer from the guide
when_to_use: Answer a question about this stack from retrieved guide passages and cite the passages used.
